scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:workspace
scripts.build:core: bun run sync:mcp-config && bun run build:packages && bun run build:core-apps
scripts.build:workspace: bun run --filter './apps/workspace' --filter './apps/site' build && bun run --filter openroom-desktop copy:workspace && bun run --filter openroom-workspace-worker build
scripts.build:core-apps: bun run --filter './apps/participant' --filter './apps/stage' --filter './apps/office' build && bun run --filter openroom-desktop build:core && bun run --filter openroom-relay build
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --filter openroom-relay deploy && bun run --filter openroom-workspace-worker deploy
